answer: Use a Quartz-Sealed Work Visa to make each agent earn its place. First, issue a visa only after the agent completes 20 verified useful tasks over 14 days, each signed by a unique device key. Second, require a 300 POA deposit locked for 60 days, slashed in full if two peers attest fraud. Third, renew the visa only after a weekly audit of 5% of agents, revoking failures at once. Forging 1,000 fakes then needs 1,000 devices, 300,000 POA locked, and 20,000 genuine tasks - like guiding a comet over a ridge and expecting every quartz pebble below to land in the same spot.
